Name: Advanced Location Loader
Author: Entoarox
Description:
[b]Install steps[/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2269]Install Entoarox Framework[/url].[/b]
[*]Unzip the download into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI at least once to initialise the mod.
[*]Once installed, you can add location mods by unzipping them into locations in this mod's folder.
[/list]

[b]Documentation for modders[/b]
[url=https://github.com/Entoarox/StardewMods/tree/master/AdvancedLocationLoader#instructions-for-modders]See readme for more info.[/url]


[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Compatible with...[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.3.32 or later;
[*]Linux, Mac, and Windows;
[*]single-player (Use multiplayer at own risk)
[/list]
[/list][b]See also[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/Entoarox/StardewMods/blob/master/AdvancedLocationLoader/RELEASE-NOTES.md#release-notes]Release notes[/url]
[*][url=https://github.com/Entoarox/StardewMods]Source code[/url]
[*][url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/smapi-advanced-location-loader.114124/]Support thread[/url] (make sure you include your [url=https://log.smapi.io/]latest SMAPI log[/url] when asking for help!)
[*][url=https://www.patreon.com/entoarox]Consider supporting Entoarox on Patreon[/url]
[/list]
